changes: First public release: deterministic engine (demars-core), stage tools, judgment layer (mar-analyst, mar-reviewer, mar-batch), episodes and defect ledger.
Tag-anchored version state with frozen/mutable modes enforced by the Claude Code hooks.
known_limits: gates.hull needs a Materials Project API key; without it the gate stays not_run (unchecked).
The ordered-sibling search needs a user-built local ICSD index (assets/icsd_query); no ICSD data ships.
hull.tol_eV_per_atom has no default, so gates.hull reports E_above_hull with pass: null until a threshold is configured.
The frozen-state check requires a git clone with the release tag; a source zip without .git cannot run the judgment layer.
